text: The data shows that significant forest clearing occurred in 2021, with a total loss of 81.3 hectares (2.2% of the property). The area was mostly planted pine forest (*Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*). However, there is no evidence of recent clearing beyond 2021—no additional losses were detected in the annual data up to 2025. While smaller patches (37.3 ha) were cleared in 2021 but were too small to count as an event, no further activity is recorded. The latest observation (2025) confirms no ongoing clearing. The property appears stable since 2021.
